description: This line plot, titled “ChatGPT on Songs,” illustrates three performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—as functions of Question Popularity, which ranges from 5 to 25 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” spans from 0.55 to 1.00 in linear scale. The blue line with circular markers represents Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.60 when Question Popularity is 5, rising to about 0.81 at Question Popularity 10, dipping to roughly 0.70 at 13, and then increasing to about 0.88 at 25. The green line with triangle markers depicts Confidence, beginning near 0.93 at Question Popularity 5, fluctuating slightly above 0.95 until approximately 15, and then stabilizing near 0.98 through Question Popularity 25. The red line with square markers shows Alignment, starting at approximately 0.69 at Question Popularity 5, rising to about 0.85 at 10, dipping to roughly 0.78 at 13, increasing again to approximately 0.85 at 17, and then continuing to rise to about 0.90 at 25.
